  WHY: On consumer repositories with leaked tracked workflow-helper copies, the commit can either trip the downstream commit gate or silently ship protected-path modifications that the pipeline explicitly refuses to carry.

  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The early-commit branch does not handle `git commit` failure with structured diagnostics.
  WHY: A commit failure leaves `MERGE_HEAD` in place and emits only raw Git stderr, so failure-triage, Telegram surfaces, retry-state, and fingerprint machinery receive no structured reason.
